whenToUse: You also show the steps still ahead.
whenNotToUse: Lists where content matters more than order (use a list).
People move through the steps themselves (use a stepper).
There are very many records (use a list grouped by date).
accessibility: Convey the order with an ol list; the latest step has aria-current="step".
Steps that haven't happened yet show "Upcoming" in words.
Dots and lines are decorative, so they're aria-hidden.
Times are shown in words too.
